turns.question: Which of 1 or 2 October 2026 had more precipitation in Amsterdam, and how many orders were placed by customers in the Netherlands on that day?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no precipitation or weather metric, so I cannot say which day was wetter, and no metric is close enough to stand in for it. Orders placed by customers in the Netherlands were 3 on 1 October 2026 and 3 on 2 October 2026 (order count, by the day placed), so the two days are level at 3 each.
